module: 'Flexbody Debug' window of the live Vehicle Editor, to diagnose the vehicle's flexbodies (deformable meshes). 'Single Flexmesh' tab: choose a flexbody (sorted combo, favorites), set the mesh visibility, display the chosen flexbody, pick a node or a vertex with the mouse within a 'Max Dist from Cursor' radius (0 to 10 m) and visualize their relationships. 'All Flexmeshes' tab: find vertices without a nearby node and (expert mode) vertices with out-of-range coordinates. Depends on editor_veMain.
notes: The per-vehicle settings (favorites) are saved in /settings/editor/flexbodyDebug_settings.json, keyed by JBeam file name.
The state is kept per vehicle ID (deep copy of vehData); onVehicleSpawned deletes the state of the respawned vehicle so that it is rebuilt.
Internal modes: default, node picking, nodes picked, vertex picking, vertices picked, display of vertices without nearby nodes.
The search for vertices without nearby nodes enables vehicle:setFlexmeshDebugMode(true) and walks through all flexbodies: can be slow on a large vehicle.
Drawing uses debugDrawer (drawLine, drawSphere, drawTextAdvanced) in the onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams hook.

onVehicleEditorRenderJBeams.desc: Render hook emitted by editor_veMain: draws the selected flexbody and runs the node/vertex picking according to the current mode.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: initializes the vehicle state, draws the tabbed window and the side windows (out-of-range vertices, vertices without nodes).

onVehicleSwitched.desc: On vehicle change, switches to the state of the new vehicle (or creates it).

onVehicleSpawned.desc: When a vehicle spawns, forgets its remembered data.
